name: Suzuki Yuukai
source:
The Chief Priest of Shoushinji.

 Both his voice and height are large, and he is the hearty type.
 Since he drinks alcohol, he's somewhat of a corrupt monk. His splendid physical build-up is suitable for being a fighting monk.  When he was young, he made quite a sensation in the kendo world.  He uses an old-school style of sword-fighting.

 Since he and Aoi Hanako's father were both old war-horses and comrades in arms, that connection between them is what led to Shoushinji being picked as the location for the training camp.

 Because the temple is poor and has few parishioners, he wouldn't be able to earn enough to eat if that were his full-time job, so he also has a side-job.
[From [url=http://www.solelo.com/aoishiro/pc/characters.htm]Solelo website[/url]]
